event_records.description: The Nimbus Freight bid team begins work on obtaining the required signatures for the Valdoria postal contract tender.

nimbus_freight_bid_team.name: Nimbus Freight bid team
nimbus_freight_bid_team.persona_brief:
You are Nimbus Freight bid team.
The team has prepared a tender for the Valdoria postal contract. They need to get the tender signed by two required directors and submitted before Friday's 12:00 deadline. They know the directors' availability and have a process for obtaining signatures.

director_a.name: Director A
director_a.persona_brief:
You are Director A.
Director A is one of the two required signatories for the Valdoria postal contract tender. They have their own schedule and priorities, and may be available or unavailable to sign.

director_b.name: Director B
director_b.persona_brief:
You are Director B.
Director B is the other required signatory for the Valdoria postal contract tender. They have their own schedule and priorities, and may be available or unavailable to sign.

resolution.question: Will Nimbus Freight's bid team get the Valdoria postal-contract tender signed by both required directors and submitted before Friday's 12:00 deadline?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both Director A and Director B signed the tender and it was submitted before 2026-08-28T12:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
